pr.title: fix(context): single body overrides other returns

summary: This PR adds TypeScript type refinement to the `body()` method by making it return `Response & TypedResponse<..., U, 'body'>` instead of just `Response`, allowing the type system to track status codes across multiple response methods in a single route. The implementation is unchanged (just cast to the new type), and a new type test validates the union of status codes works correctly.
